purpose: calibrated multi-view donor prefill before residual video inpainting
promotion_blocker: semantic texture continuity review is required

next_stage.residual_inpainting: run ProPainter only on masks/*.png residual holes
next_stage.geometry: rerun depth and normal estimation on accepted clean plates before PGSR/TSDF; the recorded DA3 arrays are evidence only and must not be reused as output depth

limitations: Forward splatting cannot reveal a surface that is absent from every donor view.
DA3 depth noise can misregister high-frequency bedding texture across views.
Technical coverage and exact outside-mask preservation do not certify semantic quality.
